fusions.name: Full Stop
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. Sends a full stop into the first enemy it meets that deals 22 damage.

fusions.name: Spoken Edict
fusions.desc: Reads out an edict that deals 26 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Counter-Script
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, your counter-script returns 30% of the elemental damage you take to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Corrected Spelling
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, 4 mana is returned to you. Once every 6 seconds.
